hero.ability2: Pair: Move a Minion on a Player’s Field to another Minion slot on their Field. Then gain 1 Lifeforce.

hero.ability4: Three of a Kind: Destroy a Magic Card.
hero.ability5: Straight: Cast a Spell from your Deck or Graveyard with cost no higher than the highest-cost card used to form this Hand. Then banish the Spell to the Void.
hero.ability6: Full House: Inflict 3 damage to a Target and gain 2 Lifeforce.
hero.ability7: Four of a Kind: Summon a Minion from your Deck with Lifeforce cost no higher than half the total cost of the cards used to form this Hand. At your End of Turn, place it on the bottom of your Deck.
